newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ wholesale sales edge up in December qtr - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ wholesale sales edge up in December qtr - SNZ.

text.p: New Zealand wholesale sales reached NZ$12.74 billion in the December quarter, a rise of 0.7 percent when compared to the December 1995 quarter, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
SNZ said results from its wholesale trade survey showed the value of stock held at December 30 was $6.63 billion, up 1.0 percent from the same time last year.

Seven of the 13 wholesale storetypes recorded increases when compared with last year. Primary product foods recorded the largest increase, rising 11.2 percent, and petrol and petroleum products rose 10.9 percent. Paper and paper products were up 7.5 percent and building materials rose 7.4 percent.
Machinery and equipment prices eased 10.6 percent and household appliances and furniture eased 5.4 percent.
For the year ended December total wholesale sales were valued at $48.46 billion, up 1.6 percent or $760 million on last year.
